facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: uncontrolled movement of PR-9410 during start-up after maintenance

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control LIFTING_GEAR_INSPECTION: the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control LIFT_STUDY_APPROVAL: the preparation and approval of a lift study had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear on PR-9410 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and executing a lift, specifically preparing and approving a lift study. PR-9410 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear had degraded below its design intent. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 1 January 2023 an incident occurred on PR-9410 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during start-up after maintenance, releasing gravity energy held as suspended load.
